title: Workplace Cafe Management Program Service Model Admission Standards
content:
## Admission Standards Table

This schedule of the Workplace Cafe Management Program fixes the admission standards a site must meet before the cafe management contract may be held under each service model: the badged headcount served, the annual food spend committed, whether a dedicated kitchen is required, and whether loading access is required.

| Service model | Badged headcount served (minimum) | Annual food spend committed (minimum, USD) | Dedicated kitchen required | Loading access required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grab & Go Cafe Service | 40 | 26000.00 USD | No | No |
| Limited Service Cafe | 120 | 78000.00 USD | No | Yes |
| Full Service Cafe | 300 | 265000.00 USD | Yes | Yes |
| Culinary Center Cafe | 650 | 610000.00 USD | Yes | Yes |
| Executive Dining Service | 90 | 340000.00 USD | Yes | No |
| Campus Dining Commons Service | 1800 | 1450000.00 USD | Yes | Yes |

### Distinguishing Notes

The badged headcount served and the annual food spend committed both rise with service model tier, though not in strict lockstep: the Executive Dining Service model carries a lower badged headcount served than the Limited Service Cafe or Full Service Cafe models while carrying a higher annual food spend committed, reflecting a smaller population served at a richer spend per head. A dedicated kitchen is required for every service model above Limited Service Cafe. Loading access is required for every service model except Grab & Go Cafe Service and Executive Dining Service.

### Hypothetical Site Illustration

Consider a hypothetical client site with a badged headcount served of 100 and an annual food spend committed of 80000.00 USD. Measured against this schedule, that site's badged headcount served and annual food spend committed both clear the Grab & Go Cafe Service standard of 40 and 26000.00 USD. The same site's annual food spend committed of 80000.00 USD also clears the 78000.00 USD standard printed against Limited Service Cafe, yet its badged headcount served of 100 does not reach the 120 standard fixed for that service model.
